best_idea: A faction standing is a personal value kept inside a range set by the faction's base, a hit spreads to linked factions by a per-link multiplier, and the hostile flag is the lowest band of one number rather than a separate state.
decision_why: Keep the clamped personal range, the base-relative bands and the linked-faction spread; reward server-verified contributors instead of every client on the hate list (the donor gives the full hit to each); fix the zero-modifier defect.
acceptance: After a kill, a player who dealt damage sees their con with that NPC's faction move to the next band; a second kill raises the value but never past the zone's range ceiling; a server test asserts that a zero association modifier changes nothing and that a negative hit never raises standing in a linked faction.
